response.justification: Bogdan is a strong candidate due to his extensive, hands-on experience in the geospatial domain, notably as the founder of GISCollective, a geo-data platform. His background in building low-latency, high-throughput microservices with DLang demonstrates relevant systems programming and distributed systems skills. While he lacks recent, professional C++ or Rust experience, his demonstrated ability to work across diverse technologies and his deep systems-level knowledge make him a compelling candidate who could likely transition effectively. An interview is recommended to assess his C++ knowledge and his ability to ramp up quickly.
strengths: Deep, practical experience in the geospatial domain, including founding a GIS data platform.
Proven experience building low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems in a production environment.
Demonstrates a strong ability to learn and work across a wide variety of technologies, from embedded to web.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with the primary required language, C++, or the alternative, Rust.
Most recent roles have focused on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems programming.
Experience is in general GIS data platforms, not specifically in the niche of routing tile generation or navigation pipelines.
